<title level="1" right="Spell 4" pfs="Standard">
[Peaceful Bubble](/Spells.aspx?ID=1624)
<actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 348

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)

**Deities**
[Bastet](/Deities.aspx?ID=50), [Count Ranalc](/Deities.aspx?ID=92), [Nivi Rhombodazzle](/Deities.aspx?ID=44), [Tsukiyo](/Deities.aspx?ID=317)

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** 10 minutes

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** touch

**Area** 100-foot burst

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 24 hours
</row>

</column>

---

An opaque shell of drifting, iridescent runes covers the area, creating a bubble. You can choose to make the burst smaller, in 10-foot increments. The runes don't block travel, but those inside the bubble can't perceive those outside it and vice versa. [Detection](/Traits.aspx?ID=43) and [scrying](/Traits.aspx?ID=141) effects are likewise blocked.

 Creatures sleeping within the bubble are immune to dreams sent by spells. Those sleeping 8 hours reduce their [doomed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=9) condition by 2 instead of 1.
name: Peaceful Bubble
